The card is full: 12.755 GB of 12.885 GB is held by this fold, and the 130.4 MB left is in pieces of at most 1.5 MB a bank against the 5.9 MB a bank this 71.3 MB request needs.
What to do: run a smaller complex. The token axis is the complex BindCraft 2 built, padded to a multiple of 32 -- it is LARGER than target residues + binder length, so size the job off the 515 above and not off that sum. 3 residues off the binder takes this fold to 512 tokens. The largest axis measured to complete a gradient round on one Wormhole Galaxy chip (12.885 GB) is 512 tokens. Trimming the target to the domain you are binding is the other lever and usually the bigger one.
The allocator's own refusal follows.")
